data.description: A metamorph gains the ability to transform herself into another form. This ability functions like

, except as noted here. The effect lasts for %1 hours or until she changes back. Changing form (to another form or back) is a standard action that doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. The metamorph is fatigued for 1 round each time she changes shape.|AlchemistLVL
